In this work, a low-cost biomedical titanium alloy Tie5MoeFee3Sn (atomic percent) was successfully developed. The microstructure, tensile properties and deformation behaviour were investigated at ambient temperature. It was found that the combined addition of Sn and Fe suppressed the formation of athermal omega phase and introduced solid solution strengthening. An excellent combination of low elastic modulus (52 GPa) and high yield strength (740 MPa) was achieved, leading to a high elastic admissible strain (1.42%).
